pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which German word or phrase means "good night"? (1 mark)
   A. Hallo
   B. Gute Nacht
   C. Sehr gut
   D. Ja

2. What does "Und dir?" mean? (1 mark)
   A. And where?
   B. And you?
   C. And who?
   D. And me?

3. What is the plural of "das Kind"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kinder
   B. die Kinds
   C. die Kinden
   D. die Kinde

4. Which little word goes with the noun "Tante"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. den
   D. das

5. Which German word means "kind"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. nett
   B. stark
   C. lustig
   D. klein

6. Which form completes "Ihr ___ ein Haus"? (1 mark)
   A. habe
   B. hast
   C. hat
   D. habt

7. Which German word or phrase means "clock"? (1 mark)
   A. die Uhr
   B. der Stuhl
   C. das Sofa
   D. der Topf

8. Which little word goes with the noun "Badezimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

9. Which little word goes with the noun "Dienstag"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

10. What does "schwimmen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to sing
   C. to swim
   D. to have a shower

11. What does "der neunte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ninth
   B. eighth
   C. third
   D. tenth

12. Which German word or phrase means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. die Party
   B. der Luftballon
   C. der Geburtstag
   D. die Kerze

13. Which German word or phrase means "bean"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohne
   B. die Mango
   C. die Wassermelone
   D. die Zwiebel

14. Which German word or phrase means "breakfast"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kohl
   B. das Frühstück
   C. die Banane
   D. der Mais

15. What is the plural of "das Auge"? (1 mark)
   A. die Auges
   B. die Augene
   C. die Auge
   D. die Augen

16. Which German word or phrase means "arm"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kopf
   B. die Nase
   C. der Arm
   D. das Knie

17. What does "Gestern war es windig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday it was windy
   B. Today it is windy
   C. Tomorrow it will be windy
   D. It is always windy

18. What does "windig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. windy
   C. wet
   D. cool

19. What does "vor" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. in front of
   C. behind
   D. next to

20. Which article follows "in" for "die Küche"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. dem
   D. die

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective. (3 marks)

22. Give two safety rules for sending messages online. (2 marks)

23. Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa. (4 marks)

24. Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose. (5 marks)

25. Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese. (5 marks)

26. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese. (3 marks)

27. Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg. (3 marks)

28. Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Gute Nacht
   good night in German is Gute Nacht.

2. B — And you?
   Und dir? asks the same question back.

3. A — die Kinder
   The plural of das Kind is die Kinder.

4. A — die
   It is die Tante, so the little word is die.

5. A — nett
   kind in German is nett.

6. D — habt
   ihr goes with habt.

7. A — die Uhr
   clock in German is die Uhr.

8. A — das
   It is das Badezimmer, so the little word is das.

9. B — der
   It is der Dienstag, so the little word is der.

10. C — to swim
   schwimmen means to swim.

11. A — ninth
   der neunte means ninth.

12. C — der Geburtstag
   birthday in German is der Geburtstag.

13. A — die Bohne
   bean in German is die Bohne.

14. B — das Frühstück
   breakfast in German is das Frühstück.

15. D — die Augen
   The plural of das Auge is die Augen.

16. C — der Arm
   arm in German is der Arm.

17. A — Yesterday it was windy
   gestern = yesterday and war = was.

18. B — windy
   windig means windy.

19. B — in front of
   vor means in front of.

20. B — der
   in der Küche is correct.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).
